entities.summary: Carl Theodor Setterberg, was a Swedish apothecary, commerce chemist and industrialist. He passed the apothecary exam in 1876. 1879–1891, studied at University of Bonn, Heidelberg University and University of Jena, where he became PhD in 1881. He was a founding member of Svenska Uppfinnareföreningen together with Salomon August Andrée, Gustaf de Laval, Otto Fahnehjelm and Ernst August Wiman in 1886, where he became honorary commissioner in 1936.
